comparison.objective: Candidate depins one connector terminal; record levels a shelf by relocating one pull pin.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed blade insertion while bending and pulling a wire versus extracting, aligning, and reseating a support pin without disturbing three others.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intended terminal release with no neighbor release or damage; force/damage thresholds are missing. Record requires all pins seated at one level, a supported level shelf, hands clear, and strict limits on other-pin motion.
comparison.reason: Both involve selective removal near neighboring retained parts, but the candidate tests latch depression and coupled wire/tool withdrawal, while the record tests structural pin relocation and load support.
